Thanks,
Daniel

Best,
Cynthia

- My notes from our advising sessions
- Our email correspondence
- The budget plans we've built together

messages.text: Standup: CNC line efficiency audit in progress. Preliminary numbers look good, should have the full report by end of week.
ventilation still running rough in bay 3, anyone else notice? airflow feels weaker than usual in the spray area
yeah its been like that for a while. ran a smoke test last week, draw is way off
i filed a work order on it back in july. nothing happened.
same, put in a request in august. got told next quarter
with the solvents in the coating process thats not great. should we escalate?
Daniel — I saw your message in plant-ops about Bay 3 ventilation. Let's keep facility issues in maintenance tickets, not public channels. I don't want the team speculating.
Understood, sorry about that. Just wanted to check if anyone else was seeing it
I get it. I'll follow up with facilities.
glad everyone's ok today
that was close. she was pretty out of it for a minute there
are we filing anything on this?
Cynthia said she's handling it

need a hand with the Bay 3 walkthrough? I have a gap after 10
that'd be great, meet at the eng office at 10?
good session today. everybody make sure your PPE checklists are in by friday

any movement on the ventilation work order?
still open. facilities says Q1 at the earliest

Standup: Bay 3 spray nozzle calibration data collected. Comparing to baseline readings. Variance report by EOD.
Standup: Q1 throughput targets drafted. Running CNC line changeover time analysis. Also updating Bay 3 ventilation monitoring log for safety committee.
Standup: reviewing safety committee action items from last week. Facilities hasn't confirmed Bay 3 ventilation timeline. Following up today.
dude why are you always on at 3am lol
early bird life 🐦😂 can’t help it
Daniel, I noticed some of your status updates are timestamped very early. Make sure you’re logging hours correctly.
Sorry about that, I sometimes draft notes early and forget to wait. I’ll be more careful with the timing.
Standup: CNC changeover optimization proposal ready for Cynthia review. Waiting on Q4 production numbers from Lisa to finalize throughput projections.
Standup: closing out Bay 3 spray coating report. Final ventilation readings improved since partial repair. Still recommending full overhaul for Q2.
Daniel — reminder that self-assessments are due by end of day Tuesday. I want to discuss core hours availability during your review. Make sure your writeup addresses your schedule.
Will do, thanks for the heads up. I’ll have it ready before the deadline.
I’ve booked your review for Thursday the 29th at 3:00 in my office. Check your calendar.
Sounds good, see you Thursday.
Standup: wrapping up self-assessment writeup today. Continuing Bay 3 ventilation follow-up with facilities.
same here. did you include the Bay 3 nozzle calibration work?
yeah that and the full process review. felt good writing it all up
anyone else still working on their self-assessment or is it just me
same. scrolling through six months of standup notes trying to remember what i did
haha i kept a running list this year, made it way easier
Standup: prepping notes for performance review tomorrow. Will update on Bay 3 ventilation status and CNC Q1 proposal.
Standup: finalizing Q1 throughput proposal for CNC Lines 2 and 3. Review with Cynthia at 3 today.
Good conversation today. I’ve sent the review summary to your work email. Let me know if you have questions.
Thanks Cynthia, I appreciate the feedback. Will sign and return the summary this week.
Standup: starting Q1 planning for CNC Lines 2 and 3 expansion per review goals. Pulling baseline data from Line 1 optimization.
